Basically any power that your 750ti would spend driving the secondary displays if it were the sole GPU is saved by driving them using the 650 instead. I'm not sure if there is a noticeable difference in gaming performance by doing it that way but if your PSU can handle it I don't see why not.

Both cards are running independently of each other(Because obviously SLI isn't allowed*), The 650 is driving two and the 750ti is driving the main. The motherboard is approaching them as their own video outputs, so they can each be used that way.

Now if you feel like getting really messy, and I won't give you my blessing or wholesome support on this, there is a "patcher" that's been in development for a long time to allow basically any SLI capable card to SLI at the cost of instability, especially if the amounts of vram don't match. It's called DifferentSLIAuto
